data.design: Paved waterfront streets and wooden sailing ships with legible quay and pier access. Wet stone, weathered wood, nets and small lantern warmth under permanent night. Customs warehouse, crates, moorings, fish stall and a small memorial to absence. No invented named disaster on the memorial or early mythological shipping conspiracy.

description:
Wet stone quays, warehouses and moored wooden ships connect coastal lives through flour, oil, hinges, letters and trade. Crew members know particular routes and tasks. Their ordinary work opens the world without explaining its cosmology.

The Salt Thread carries ordinary coastal cargo; the Little Promise is preparing for the island crossing. Ship and sailor names are implementation choices.

Team Abyss’s theft, fencing and illegal distribution operate beside ordinary trade here. The old storehouse sends stolen coastal goods toward dock buyers; that does not make every crew member an accomplice. Later, the museum theft uses this wider criminal network.

Proposed working detail: cargo is counted aloud while one worker checks the destination marks. A split sack is weighed again, with its loss recorded rather than quietly passed to the buyer. The regular crews need the same dry storage and loading space as the fences. A reused crate or familiar wrapping alone therefore proves little; a missing shop order and a buyer offering its still-marked bottles together can establish a particular theft. Returning one consignment lets work resume without dismantling the whole organisation.

Proposed sound: let the cargo count pause under a creaking mooring rope, then resume when the load is set down. Water knocks beneath the quay; a loose ring taps wood between voices. Music can leave those intervals audible so a later abandoned berth is recognized by a missing work rhythm.

data.description: The Little Promise prepares an intended supply crossing; sailing and arrival have not yet been implemented.

sections: §§5.11, 8.1 and 30: legitimate cargo, fencing and the museum network; proposed specific delivery routine is new.

data.description: Proposed regular route: lamp oil arrives by coastal ship, then travels along the South Coast Road to the seller. Native dialogue establishes oil cargo, but this particular supply arrangement is new.
